name: help-scout
description: Reads Help Scout Inbox API resources and exposes typed reverse-ETL actions for documented mutations through approval and destructive-confirmation gates.

risk.read: external Help Scout Inbox API reads of conversations, customers, inbox metadata, users, teams, tags, organizations, webhooks, and related configuration resources
risk.write: external Help Scout Inbox API mutations; every action is available only through reverse ETL plan, preview, explicit approval, and typed destructive confirmation
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan -> preview -> approval token -> execute, and this bundle marks every Help Scout write confirm=destructive for captain-policy safety

conformance.reason: oauth2_client_credentials auth requires a real token_url and client credentials; conformance synthetic config cannot perform the token exchange, so auth-dependent fixture replay is skipped. Static checks, operation-ledger validation, write-schema validation, sanitized fixtures, and connector-local Help Scout full-surface tests are the substitute evidence; no live provider call or certification claim is made.
